subject: How to adjust the protobuf header directory on install?

messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: How to adjust the protobuf header directory on install?
parts:
Hi, I am trying to install the new version of Rhipe on the Rossmann
High Performance Computing cluster.

I had them install protobuf version 2.4.1 to support the effort and
adjusted my modules.

Trying to install I get:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[09:38:43 jrounds@rossmann-h000 ~]$ R CMD INSTALL --no-lock -l ~/
R_LIBS/ Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz.1
* installing *source* package 'Rhipe' ...
checking <blah blah blah>
g++ -I/apps/rhel5/R-2.11.1/lib64/R/include -I/usr/local/include -
fpic -g -O2 -I. -g -DHAVE_UINTPTR_T `pkg-config --cflags protobuf` -
Wall -c display.cc -o display.o
In file included from display.cc:1:
ream.h:8:42: error: google/protobuf/stubs/common.h: No such file or
directory
LOTS OF ERRORS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

My initial read of the situation is that I need to communicate lib
headers to R CMD INSTALL for g++.

If your curious my protobuf related environmental variables are:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[09:43:05 jrounds@rossmann-h000 ~]$ env | grep protobuf
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/apps/rhel5/R-2.11.1/lib64/R/lib:/apps/coates/
gcc-4.4.0/lib64:/apps/coates/gcc-4.4.0/lib:/apps/coates/mpfr-2.4.1/
lib:/apps/rhel5/protobuf-2.4.1/lib
PROTOBUF_HOME=/apps/rhel5/protobuf-2.4.1
PATH=/apps/rhel5/R-2.11.1/bin:/apps/coates/gcc-4.4.0/bin:/apps/rhel5/
protobuf-2.4.1/bin:/apps/rhel5/protobuf-2.4.1/java:/apps/rhel5/
git-1.6.5.rc2/bin:/usr/lib64/qt-3.3/bin:/usr/kerberos/bin:/bin:/usr/
bin:/opt/hpss/bin:/opt/hsi/bin:/usr/pbs/bin:/opt/hpss/bin:/opt/hsi/
bin:/usr/pbs/bin
_LMFILES_=/opt/modules/modulefiles/git/1.6.5:/opt/modules/modulefiles/
protobuf/2.4.1:/opt/modules/modulefiles/gcc/4.4.0:/opt/modules/
modulefiles/R/2.11.1
LOADEDMODULES=git/1.6.5:protobuf/2.4.1:gcc/4.4.0:R/2.11.1
PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/apps/rhel5/protobuf-2.4.1/lib/pkgconfig
PBS_O_PATH=/apps/rhel5/R-2.11.1/bin:/apps/coates/gcc-4.4.0/bin:/apps/
rhel5/protobuf-2.3.0/bin:/apps/rhel5/protobuf-2.3.0/java:/apps/rhel5/
git-1.6.5.rc2/bin:/usr/lib64/qt-3.3/bin:/usr/kerberos/bin:/usr/local/
bin:/bin:/usr/bin:/opt/hpss/bin:/opt/hsi/bin:/usr/pbs/bin:/opt/hpss/
bin:/opt/hsi/bin:/usr/pbs/bin
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


I looked around in some of these directories and couldn't find the
headers. I do have the google source for protobuf with that file in
it, but I don't want to do another google protobuf install over the
top of the PBS module system. I think this boils down to the right
command line argument. Those headers are currently in: ~/
protobuf-2.4.1/src/google/protobuf/stubs/ Any idea how to install
from this situation?


Thanks,

Jeremiah

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] How to adjust the protobuf header directory on install?
parts:
That it can't find the headers probably means that pkgconfig could not
find the link.
You should ask the rossmann sysadmins to provide help on how to make
PBS play well with pkgconfig -
which as you poiinted out boils down to loading the correct version of
the protobuf module.

messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: Re: How to adjust the protobuf header directory on install?
parts:
BTW Saptarshi your first remark was dead on.

With "module load protobuf" and then "pkg-config --cflags protobuf"
the result is "-pthread -I/apps/rhel5/protobuf-2.3.0//include"

While with "module load protobuf/2.4.1" and then "pkg-config --cflags
protobuf" the result is "-pthread -I/home/ba01/u100/jmulesa/
protobuf-2.4.1/include"

And that last one is a non-existent user home directory. I got a
ticket in with help to see if they want to tackle it.
